sunil.note: ADR-030 §5 role 1 — n8n is the SCHEDULER. It supplies the clock and the instruction text; every decision is SUNIL's, made inside the turn this POST starts. Nothing here reads or writes SUNIL's database.

nodes.name: 07:00 weekdays (Australia/Melbourne)
nodes.notes: The workflow's timezone is pinned in settings.timezone, not inherited: a brief that silently moves an hour on a DST boundary is worse than one that does not run.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: "Good morning. Prepare Isuru's brief for today across the active Codely engagements. For each one: what moved in the last 24 hours, which pull requests are waiting on a review, and anything that slipped. Finish with the single most important thing to do today. Ten lines at most, no preamble.", channel_label: "n8n:morning-brief" }) }}

nodes.name: POST /api/v1/chat
nodes.notes: The bearer is an n8n CREDENTIAL, never a literal in this file (scripts/n8n-setup.* creates it from SUNIL_SERVICE_TOKEN and substitutes the id). neverError + onError:continueRegularOutput because the API may legitimately be down: a scheduled brief that cannot reach SUNIL must record that and stop, not retry itself into a red execution list.
